meta.title: Miinohara Ski Resort
meta.description: Two minutes on foot from Miinohara Station on the JR Kisuki Line — rope-tow snow play and snow debut. Hinokami Onsen and highland soba in Okuizumo.

hero.title:
Miinohara
Ski Resort
hero.tagline: Zero chairlifts, zero worries! Japan's premier snow-debut park just 2 minutes from a snowy station, perfectly paired with local hot springs and legendary Soba.

transit.title:
Two minutes from the station,
straight into the snow.
transit.lead: About 2 minutes on foot from JR Kisuki Line Miinohara Station — one of Japan's rare ski areas you can reach entirely by train. The approach crosses the tracks, making the local line running through snowfields a signature photo spot.
specs: One of JR's highest hidden stations
transit.imgAlt: JR Kisuki Line in winter snow — local train near Miinohara Station

primary.title: No lifts · rope-tow snow play only
primary.lead: With no chairlifts, first snow feels safe — a snow-debut park built around rope tows and gentle slopes. Perfect for families and first-timers who want snowmen, sledding, and easy runs rather than steep descents.
primary.imgAlt: Gentle snowy slope at Miinohara — rope tow and hidden-station views

secondary.title: Low-impact eco snow play
secondary.lead: Natural terrain without lift operations — branded as a carbon-neutral snow park offering safe, approachable winter outdoor fun (report proposal).

pass.title:
Okuizumo winter
indulgence package
pass.lead: A bundled ticket concept: full-day rope tow, sled and wear rental, lunch at Kogen Soba Issin, and Hinokami Onsen entry (LP proposal). Online prepayment lifts spend across the area.
pass.noticeBody: Sell via platforms like Asoview! or KKday so scattered local tickets complete on your phone — less staff load, smoother trips (report ch.7).
pass.imgAlt: Day trip pairing snow play with Okuizumo food and hot springs

rental.title:
Arrive empty-handed,
play in the snow.
rental.lead: Bundle sled and wear rental into packages — rail travelers walk 2 minutes from the station and start playing. A hands-free model that fits snow-train tourism (LP proposal).
rental.whisper: A shared digital pass across local inns and drive-ins optimizes pickup and stock area-wide.
rental.imgAlt: Family starting sled play with rental gear — train-friendly snow trip

yukinko.title:
Dusk on the plateau
and the Kisuki Line.
yukinko.lead: At 700 m+, evening snow light and the local line — the trackside approach becomes a designated photo zone with safe viewing (report proposal).
yukinko.whisper: Designed with JR West and local police: no track trespassing, signed official photo spots.
yukinko.imgAlt: Snowfield at dusk with the JR Kisuki Line — Okuizumo winter scene

family.title:
First snow,
without the fear.
family.lead: Lift-free gentle slopes — for visitors from Taiwan and Southeast Asia seeking first-snow experiences without steep-run anxiety. Snowmen, sledding, and light runs in a safe playground. Concept: first snow play at JR's highest hidden station.
family.noticeBody: Rebrand as Miinohara Snow Debut Park — photos and sled play over expert skiing (report ch.7).
family.imgAlt: Family sledding on a gentle snowfield — snow debut zone

spa.title:
After the snow,
soba and silky hot spring.
spa.lead: Lunch buckwheat noodles at Kogen Soba Issin, then recovery at Hinokami Onsen Hinokami-so — the classic Okuizumo day loop of snow, food, and bath.
spa.whisper: Easy to combine with Kamedake and Sahaku hot springs across Nita County.
spa.imgAlt: Hinokami Onsen and Izumo-style soba — après-snow Okuizumo

workation.title:
Ride the Kisuki Line
for snow and onsen.
workation.lead: From Matsue, Izumo, or Hiroshima via JR Kisuki Line to Miinohara — snow-train tourism that brings winter visitors to the slope without snowy-road driving (LP proposal).

local.title: Hidden station × snow debut park guide
local.body: Flip the no-lift handicap into Japan's lowest-barrier snow resort — visualize the 2-minute walk and rope-tow-only assets with a mobile LP and live ops (report ch.7).

schools.title: Okuizumo snow & gourmet digital pass
schools.body: Unify rentals and tickets sold separately at local inns into one phone pass — mid-term DMO and DX vision (report ch.7).

summer.title: Orochi Loop & Okuizumo winter trip
summer.body: Combine Orochi Loop, Oni no Shitaaburi, and tatara heritage with Kisuki Line access for a 1-night rail winter itinerary (report ch.3).
